caption:
Some weeks the progress is all underground. It still counts.

Sunday’s energy is Yin Wood over Earth: a vine in cool soil, quietly holding on. Gentle, patient, resilient. Good for care and slow things; results may not show yet.

3 small things for everyone today:
1. Water a plant, or bring one home
2. Share a slow meal
3. Plan next week in pencil

How today meets your own chart is different. Your personal tips are free at the link in bio.
